provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: During spin-up the angle uses omega=speed0/Rship while the radius is still rship<Rship (L50-L56), so the actual speed actsp is below speed0 until t0; actsp is computed (L59) but its output column is commented out (L68), leaving the discrepancy unrecorded in vessel_0001.
audit_member_text: Nominal/actual speed mismatch across L40, L51, L55, and L59: speed0 sets only angular rate using the final Rship, while the radius changes during t<t0, so total vessel speed includes radial motion and tangential speed rship*speed0/Rship. actsp measures that differing speed but is omitted from output at L68.

base_member_text: xship/yship use the domain-centered coordinates and are shifted by +m/2*dx, +n/2*dy on output (L66-L67), implicitly assuming the model origin is the lower-left corner; not verifiable here.
audit_member_text: Grid centering at L8-L9 subtracts m/2*dx and n/2*dy from indices 0..m-1 and 0..n-1, giving even-sized ranges -500..498 rather than symmetric endpoint coordinates; the saved ship shift at L66-L67 follows the same origin convention, but the intended cell-center/edge convention is undocumented.

base_member_text: The vessel file format (header-less 3-column t,x,y named vessel_0001) must match what the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel module expects; the reader-side contract is not in this file.
Despite living in postprocessing/, this is an input-preparation script (writes depth.txt and vessel_0001).
Double semicolons at L66-L67 are typos without functional effect.

audit_member_text: Potential orientation/interface defect at L42-L44 and L65-L67: t, xship, and yship are created as row vectors and assigned directly to vessel(:,k) column slices without transposition; compatibility depends on MATLAB indexed-assignment shape handling and is not guarded.
MATLAB pcolor at L35 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; this affects only the preview, not the saved depth array.
